original_value: The ASUS GeForce GT 1030 Phoenix OC edition features a dual-ball bearing fan for superior airflow and 2X lifespan over reference. Auto-extreme manufacturing technology with Super Alloy Power II delivers premium quality and reliability. GPU Tweak II enables additional control to ensure an optimal balance between performance, cooling and noise.1531MHz boost clock (OC mode) with 2GB GDDR5 on NVIDIA's Pascal architecture. Dual-ball bearing fan provides superior airflow and cooling with 2x longer lifespan.
